about: Cat Looks Inside is a fisheye close-up of a gray and white cat peering straight down into the camera, wide eyes and pink nose filling the frame as if the lens were at the bottom of a box. Above the photo is a pale strip with three green ">" arrows, the greentext style used on 4chan. The format is a tiny story of disappointment: "> buy wireless headphones", "> look inside", "> wires". The cat's blank, curious stare is the moment of discovering that something is not what it claimed to be, whether that is a product, a promise, a pull request or a job listing.
origin: In 2022 an anonymous 4chan poster used the cat photo to illustrate a short greentext complaint about wireless devices having wires inside. Others kept the picture and swapped in their own "looks inside" discoveries.
usage:
Write it as greentext. The first box is the setup, usually something promising ("> looks inside \"quick fix\" pr"). The second box is what was actually inside ("> 3000-line diff"). Starting each line with "> " keeps it in the 4chan style.

It works best when the label and the contents contradict each other: "healthy" snacks that are mostly sugar, "low maintenance" pets, "entry level" jobs that need five years of experience, games advertised as complete. Keep both lines short; the cat's stare does the rest.
ideas: > looks inside the family chip bag
